text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Ohh, look at you, brooding all on your lonesome. Started indulging in grown-up hobbies?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Is that something adults do for fun?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Beats me. ☆

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: So? What's eating you on this final day of camp?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Um… I was just reflecting on a lot of things, like how tough training was…

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: The aches in my joints won't go away, and my body just feels really weird recently…

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Okay. And?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Still, Trainer is working really hard for my sake, and things have gotten much easier than they used to be.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: They always keep an eye out for me, and they notice even the smallest changes.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: I'm always on the receiving end of their support and encouragement…

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Sounds like you found yourself a considerate partner.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: I did!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Back when we first met, I really just wanted to make myself useful in any way I could.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: But now… I think the real reason Trainer came into my life was for my sake.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: I can continue to give it my all each and every day because my trainer is there with me.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: …Could be.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: I want to show my appreciation by winning the Sprinters Stakes.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: I know you can do it, Flower. Think about how much you put into this.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: …You'll definitely win.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: I appreciate that, Sky.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Also… I have noticed, you know!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Hm? Noticed what?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: That there's someone else who's been watching over me, always ready to pick me up when I'm feeling down.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: That person is really kind, and has always stayed close by my side…

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: They're a protector from above, beautiful and serene, just like…

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: …Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: I'm heading back now! What about you, Sky?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: …This could be our last time here, so I think I'll watch the waves a bit longer.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Okay! See you tomorrow, then!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: She really has grown up so fast…

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: No fair…

text_block_list.name: Flower's Friend A
text_block_list.text: Oh, Flower! You came at the perfect time!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Hm? Why is everybody gathered here?

text_block_list.name: Flower's Friend B
text_block_list.text: We're comparing our heights before going back to the academy. Look at that pillar!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: …Wow! There are so many lines! Are these all from past students?

text_block_list.name: Flower's Friend B
text_block_list.text: Looks like it. I asked the staff here, and apparently the owner of the building lets Umamusume use this pillar!

text_block_list.name: Flower's Friend A
text_block_list.text: Come on, Flower! I'll measure you!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: O-okay!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: With our second summer camp in the books, I'm waiting for Nishino Flower so that we can board the bus together when…

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: T-Trainer! Big news!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: I've grown a bit taller!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Ehehe! Who knows, I might shoot up ten centimeters by next summer!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Her physical changes had her at a loss at first, but after realizing they were something to celebrate, she's been able to take them in stride.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She's grown so much compared to when we first met, and she'll soon stand shoulder to shoulder with the older students she looks up to.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Thanks!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: I can't wait to compete in the Sprinters Stakes! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: As the curtain falls on our second summer camp, I have a hunch that Nishino Flower will continue to grow in both mind and body at a swift pace.
